'''Outpost Zaroshe''' was an outpost operated by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Outpost Zaroshe was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It appears as one of the Imperial settlements on the planet Tatooine.
